description: This is a Linux kernel driver source file for the PTM (Packet Transfer Mode) network interface, specifically for VR9 hardware. It includes core functions for initializing, configuring, and managing the PTM device, handling network operations, interrupts, and firmware interactions.

methods.name: cgu_get_pp32_clock
methods.description: Retrieves the current clock rate of the PP32 clock domain.

methods.name: ptm_setup
methods.description: Configures network device parameters and MAC address.

methods.name: ptm_get_stats
methods.description: Returns network statistics for the device.

methods.name: ptm_open
methods.description: Starts network device operation and enables NAPI.

methods.name: ptm_stop
methods.description: Stops network device operation and disables NAPI.

methods.name: ptm_poll
methods.description: Processes received packets from the hardware descriptor ring.

methods.name: ptm_napi_poll
methods.description: NAPI poll function for handling packet reception.

methods.name: ptm_hard_start_xmit
methods.description: Transmits a packet by preparing descriptors and updating hardware.

methods.name: ptm_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for configuration and statistics.

methods.name: ptm_tx_timeout
methods.description: Handles transmission timeout events.

methods.name: alloc_skb_rx
methods.description: Allocates a socket buffer for receiving data.

methods.name: alloc_skb_tx
methods.description: Allocates a socket buffer for transmission.

methods.name: get_skb_pointer
methods.description: Retrieves the skb pointer from a data pointer.

methods.name: get_tx_desc
methods.description: Obtains a free transmit descriptor.

methods.name: mailbox_irq_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for mailbox events.

methods.name: do_swap_desc_tasklet
methods.description: Tasklet for handling swap descriptors.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_version
methods.description: Retrieves firmware version information.

methods.name: init_priv_data
methods.description: Initializes private data structures and configuration.

methods.name: clear_priv_data
methods.description: Clears private data structures.

methods.name: init_tables
methods.description: Initializes hardware descriptors and configuration tables.

methods.name: clear_tables
methods.description: Clears hardware descriptors and configuration tables.

methods.name: ptm_showtime_enter
methods.description: Enters showtime mode, enabling network operation.

methods.name: ptm_showtime_exit
methods.description: Exits showtime mode, disabling network operation.

methods.name: ltq_ptm_probe
methods.description: Probe function for platform driver, initializes hardware and network devices.

methods.name: ltq_ptm_remove
methods.description: Cleanup function for platform driver, releases resources.
